items.title: Jadarian Price: Practices fully Friday
items.description:
Price (chest) was a full participant in Friday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

items.title: Zach Charbonnet: Practices in limited capacity
items.description:
Charbonnet (knee) was a limited participant in Friday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

items.title: Jordan Mason: Sharing backfield with Jones vs. Detroit
items.description:
Mason and Aaron Jones (knee) will share the backfield against the Lions on Sunday after the latter avoided an injury designation for Week 8, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: RJ Harvey: Shouldn't be out too long
items.description:
Harvey (knee) is ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, but his injury isn't considered severe or long term, Sam Jane of The Denver Post reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Makai Lemon: Philly's top WR for Week 8
items.description:
Lemon will be the Eagles' top wide receiver for a second consecutive game Sunday at Washington due to the absences of both DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle).

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
